issue: Under the Schlup actual-innocence gateway, must new evidence be newly discovered (unavailable or undiscoverable at trial), or is it enough that it is newly presented, with its availability at trial irrelevant?
provision: 28 U.S.C. § 2254; Schlup v. Delo gateway for procedurally barred claims

sides.position: New evidence must be newly discovered, meaning it was not available or discoverable at the time of trial.
New evidence need only be newly presented; its availability or discoverability at the time of trial is irrelevant.

quote: There is a circuit split regarding whether the testimony of these alibi witnesses qualifies under Schlup as “new” evidence of innocence.
cite: Crosley Alexander Green v. Secretary, Department of Corrections, 28 F.4th 1089 (11th Cir. 2022)
